name: database
title: Database
description: Drizzle ORM on Postgres (Neon, Supabase or any Postgres). Zero-setup embedded PGlite in development with automatic schema push.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Postgres connection string. Unset in development = embedded PGlite in .site/dev/pglite
env.howTo: Neon: console.neon.tech → Connection string (pooled). Supabase: Project settings → Database → Transaction pooler

postInstall: Development needs nothing: `pnpm dev` pushes the schema into an embedded PGlite database.
Production: set DATABASE_URL, then `pnpm db:generate` and `pnpm db:migrate` (commit the /drizzle folder).
